additional_info.subject: FW: ID0482926-DC/Si-D/CZ-[MP / R9 170002622] Charging session interupted CRM:03433000013
additional_info.body:
Dear Abhishek,
Please review the issue with DC charging session beeing interrupted.
If you refer to FC5 as the CIRCUIT BREAKER 10KA 3POL + N C32, then this is desired to be down, since custommer does not want to use AC socket on this charger.
As far as I know FC5 should not in any instance interfere with DC charging session.
Please see logs from 19.02.2026 when DC charging session was interrupted.
Start
:
2026-02-19T13:38:36.934459+00:00 [FW080005G1] swcpu [user:debug] [4322] [DCC]  DC1: EV connected: V_Max: 396[V], I_Max:500[A], P_Max:198[kW], SoC:22[%];
Error
:
2026-02-19T13:54:14.595713+00:00 [FW080005G1] swcpu [user:debug] [4322] [DCC]  DC1: PilotState "C2" --> "E"
Charge to Uknown state
:
2026-02-19T13:54:14.613234+00:00 [FW080005G1] swcpu [user:debug] [4322] [DCC]  DC1: Charging Phase "P06_CHARGE" --> "P00_UNKNOWN"
Followed with following error flags

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0482926-DC/Si-D/CZ-[MP / R9 170002622] Charging session interupted CRM:03433000013
additional_info.body:
Hi Francisco,
As we discussed on Teams, here are the suggested next steps for the charger repair:
Replace Ethernet cable from KF11 to XF1.
Replace XF1: Order 1x 8EM5903-0AA01-3AA7 (Ethernet Switch 8 Port Unmanaged).
Replace KF11 EcoG Charge controller: Order 1x 8EM5903-0AA00-6AA3.
Since the site is located far from our technician base, we have decided to replace all these parts at once to prevent lengthy troubleshooting and unnecessary travel kilometers.
Looking forward to your confirmation.
Best regards,
Milan
